<!-- pr-reviewer: 0144f249c2027edc3fa10661935466e48e4125ec -->
Needs changes before merge.

The new tokens reach the theme parser and the drawing code. The tests check default values, custom values, and clamp limits. The decision file explains the shared stroke token.

Local results, with a trial merge of upstream/main at a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504:
- The trial merge passed without conflicts.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` passed.
- From `crates/ui`, the UI library tests passed: 868 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- Integration suites passed: `boundary` 3, `boundary_picks` 6, `sinker_setup` 2, `theme_files` 15, and `waterjet_tool` 1.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- The first build failed in sccache with missing temporary output files. The build and all checks passed with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:307-311` and `:340-343`: Keep the eye and setup-radio click targets inside their own rows. The parser permits `tree_glyph_px = 64` with the default `row_height = 20`. The eye target then extends 22 pixels beyond each row edge. The setup-radio target also extends beyond the row. `ui.interact` clips these targets to the panel, not to the row. Adjacent rows therefore have overlapping controls, which can receive a click intended for another row. Intersect each click target with its row, or constrain the dimensions together. Add a pointer test with large glyphs and adjacent rows.
2. PR body, for the UI changes at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_tabs.rs:123`: Add before/after screenshots. The body has no screenshot links. Show the changed tabs, browser tree, and geometry highlight. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit images to this PR branch.

This is a UI styling review. The PR does not change posted G-code, geometry calculations, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens changed. No mutations ran; this review does not meet the safety-tier trigger. The passing tests do not cover clicks with glyphs taller than the tree rows.

The PR remains a draft and receives `needs-rework`. Its parent, #2027, remains open and must merge first.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the latest review.

1. Eye and setup-radio click targets now intersect their own rows. Painted glyph sizes stay the same.
   Pins: `large_tree_eye_clicks_stay_in_their_rows` and `large_tree_setup_radio_clicks_stay_in_their_rows`.
   Each test clicks three adjacent rows with 64 px glyphs and 20 px rows.
   Each test failed when its fix was removed. Both passed after the fixes were restored.
2. The PR body now links before and after screenshots of the tabs, browser tree, and geometry highlight.
   Both images use the same custom theme settings. The body describes the capture method.
   Images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `29c4417b`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. The UI library passed 835 tests. The integration suites passed 27 tests.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
Both checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.

New head: `91b15459cfc466684e12d0e72fa0a9306ff36b1f`.
The PR remains a draft. Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 91b15459cfc466684e12d0e72fa0a9306ff36b1f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Both findings from the earlier review are resolved:
- `painted.rs` intersects the eye and setup-radio input rectangles with their own rows. Both pointer tests pass for three adjacent rows with 64 px glyphs and 20 px row heights.
- The PR body links before and after screenshots. I opened both images. They show the tabs, browser tree, and geometry highlight. No screenshots or snapshot PNGs are added to this PR.

I checked the change against upstream/main's current AGENTS.md and UI rules. The theme parser, clamp limits, drawing code, and tests agree. The decision file records the chosen design.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2095`, with a clean trial merge of upstream/main at `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 870 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 6 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `theme_files` | 15 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

All build and test commands used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`. No GitHub runner was used. The gate dry run included unrelated main changes since the merge base. I therefore ran the UI library and the five integration suites mapped to this change directly.

This change affects UI styling and input rectangles. It does not change posted G-code, machining geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens moved. No mutations ran in this review; the safety-tier requirement does not apply.

Requested changes: none.

The PR body identifies #2027 as its parent. Keep the stated parent-first merge order.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
